1.web: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us: Look, and see our reproach.
1.asv: Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us: Behold, and see our reproach.

2.web: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, Our houses to aliens.
2.asv: Our inheritance is turned unto strangers, Our houses unto aliens.

3.web: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.
3.asv: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.

4.web: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold to us.
4.asv: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold unto us.

5.web: Our pursuers are on our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.
5.asv: Our pursuers are upon our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.

6.web: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, To the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
6.asv: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, And to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

7.web: Our fathers sinned, and are no more; We have borne their iniquities.
7.asv: Our fathers sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities.

8.web: Servants rule over us: There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
8.asv: Servants rule over us: There is none to deliver us out of their hand.

9.web: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Because of the sword of the wilderness.
9.asv: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Because of the sword of the wilderness.

10.web: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.
10.asv: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.

11.web: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.
11.asv: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.

12.web: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.
12.asv: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.

13.web: The young men bare the mill; The children stumbled under the wood.
13.asv: The young men bare the mill; And the children stumbled under the wood.

14.web: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.
14.asv: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.

15.web: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.
15.asv: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

16.web: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe to us! for we have sinned.
16.asv: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe unto us! for we have sinned.

17.web: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;
17.asv: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;

18.web: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk on it.
18.asv: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk upon it.

19.web: You, Yahweh, remain forever; Your throne is from generation to generation.
19.asv: Thou, O Jehovah, abidest for ever; Thy throne is from generation to generation.

20.web: Why do you forget us forever, And forsake us so long time?
20.asv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, Andforsake us so long time?

21.web: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we shall be turned. Renew our days as of old.
21.asv: Turn thou us unto thee, O Jehovah, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.

22.web: But you have utterly rejected us; You are very angry against us.
22.asv: But thou hast utterly rejected us; Thou art very wroth against us.
